business_problem: Brenntag’s global IT and finance operations across 72 countries were slowed by manual tasks, fragmented systems, and too much time spent searching for help or resolving routine requests.
solution_summary: Brenntag’s global IT and finance operations across 72 countries were slowed by manual tasks, fragmented systems, and too much time spent searching for help or resolving routine requests. Brenntag implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, IT Service Management, and Now Assist. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; Now Assist adds generative search, summarization, and drafting. The stack also connected SharePoint and Microsoft Teams so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by Now Assist, and uses context from SharePoint and Microsoft Teams before ServiceNow AI Platform and IT Service Management routes or fulfills the work.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Standardizes incident, request, and fulfillment workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: Now Assist
solution_components.role: Adds generative-AI capabilities such as summarization, drafting, search, and guided responses inside workflows.

data_flow: Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by Now Assist, and uses context from SharePoint and Microsoft Teams before ServiceNow AI Platform and IT Service Management routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform.
business_outcome: Brenntag expects to reduce global service tickets by 5%, lower MTTR by 30%, and cut the time users spend searching and submitting requests by 33%.
